messages:
Maya: FYI spotted a ~$6.4k untagged GPU charge this morning across several sandbox projects (sandbox-exp, sandbox-play). Putting it here before any chargebacks.

cost-bot: ALERT: Unlabeled GPU spend spike detected (2024-08-21). +55% vs 7d avg. Top clusters: sandbox-exp-*, sandbox-play-*. See alert/1789.

Carlos: Quick audit run. SQL I used to pull unlabelled spend yesterday:
```sql
SELECT project_id, SUM(cost) cost
FROM `billing.gpu_usage`
WHERE labels IS NULL AND usage_date = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY project_id
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Top rows: sandbox-exp $3,400, sandbox-play $2,000, ci-bench $1,000.

Lena: Looks like onboarding scripts still omit required tags occasionally. I propose a 7-day smoothing window for chargeback + a 48h auto-soft-tag step. That way a one-day spin-up doesn't immediately hit teams.

Maya: Agree on smoothing. Also want an exclude rule: never auto-tag if any `customer=` label exists. We must avoid touching customer costs.

Priya: Approval thresholds: finance can sign temporary internal credit up to $4k. Anything above goes to me. For automation: auto-soft-tag for project-day > $400 but < $2k. Above $2k require human review.

Carlos: Implementation sketch for automation job:
1) Nightly detector finds project/day untagged GPU cost.
2) If cost > auto threshold and no customer=* label, write a tracking row with `temp_label=finance_sandbox` (tracking DB only).
3) Post Slack ticket to #devex and notify project owner.
4) After 48h, if still no owner tags, roll into smoothing window and create chargeback draft for finance.

InfraBot: NOTE: infra templates PR to enforce `team` and `customer` labels incoming. Will add pre-commit lint to reject creations missing labels.

Lena: Also request a dashboard tile: "Untagged GPU spend (rolling 7d)" with linked owner contact. That will speed triage.

Maya: Backfill ask: can we backfill last 7 days into the tracking table so we don't lose context for smoothing?

Carlos: Yes, I can run backfill and upload CSV to FIN-4022 today. Will exclude any rows with customer=* on inventory join.

Priya: Good. If after backfill the total internal reassignments exceed $4k, I'll review and sign. If >$10k we'll escalate to CFO. Keep all decisions auditable.

Lena: I'll add the exclude filter: `AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(labels, r"customer=")` and wire up the dashboard.

Maya: Action items: (1) Carlos run backfill + CSV to FIN-4022 (EOD), (2) Lena add dashboard + pre-commit lint (2 business days), (3) Priya publish approval matrix in playbook (tomorrow), (4) Infra to land templates PR (today).

Carlos: Starting backfill now, will link the CSV here when ready.

cost-bot: SCHEDULED: Untagged-detect job set for 02:30 UTC daily.

Maya: Thanks. Keep updates in-thread and ping me if any potential customer-tagged costs show up so we don't auto-reassign. :thumbsup:
